description: This file declares functions, structures, and constants related to sparse indexing within a version control system, likely Git. It provides interfaces for managing sparse index states, expansion, and configuration.

methods.name: is_sparse_index_allowed
methods.description: Checks if sparse index is allowed given the current index state and flags.

methods.name: convert_to_sparse
methods.description: Converts the current index state to a sparse index with specified flags.

methods.name: ensure_correct_sparsity
methods.description: Ensures the index has correct sparsity settings.

methods.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files
methods.description: Removes skip-worktree entries from the index for present files.

methods.name: expand_to_path
methods.description: Expands the sparse index to include specific paths, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: set_sparse_index_config
methods.description: Configures sparse index settings for a repository.

methods.name: expand_index
methods.description: Expands the index based on pattern list, either to a full index or within sparse directories.

methods.name: ensure_full_index
methods.description: Ensures the index is fully expanded.
